title: Part gallery: render every scan's version of each part, score with a vision model, choose the best
description: For each part label, render each member's version of that part (isolated by the CRAW-24 per-face part field, hidden others, consistent camera from the part's ring centroid and skeleton branch direction, 4-6 views via the multiview render) into one contact sheet per part with member numbers drawn on (Set-of-Mark, as in CRAW-10). Human path: a `parts` section in the scene menu cycles parts, shows the sheet, and a click or `parts choose <part> <member>` records the choice. Agent path: extend the CRAW-10 Python harness with `ixdar-cli parts score` asking the vision model (Anthropic SDK, current vision-capable Claude model id pinned per the claude-api skill) to rank members per part on completeness, surface quality and plausibility, with ABSENT members excluded up front; votes across views; writes the same choice file. Choices are DSL: `parts_choice.dsl` with one `select_part(collection, part, point)`-style statement per part where the member is identified by a surface point on its chosen version rather than an index. Downstream, CRAW-16 assembly consumes the choice file to union chosen parts (cut slightly past their rings) instead of whole members; the ticket documents that contract but does not change CRAW-16.
definition-of-done: 1. For the two-scan collection every part has a contact sheet under tmp/ and the scene menu can cycle them; screenshot in VERIFICATION.md. 2. `ixdar-cli parts score` produces parts_choice.dsl that validates, excludes ABSENT members, and logs the model's per-view votes. 3. Agreement report against a hand-chosen subset of at least 8 parts is written to the ticket. 4. Human choose command writes the identical statement form. 5. Build checkstyle-green; Python side has a unit test with a stubbed model client.
testing-plan: 1. Python unit tests with a fake client returning canned rankings. 2. run-scene on the two-member collection, render sheets, score, reload parts_choice.dsl. 3. Manual review of sheets for 3 parts to confirm camera framing.
todos: Isolated-part render with camera from ring centroid + branch direction
Contact sheet per part with member numbers (Set-of-Mark)
ixdar-cli parts score (vision ranking, view voting, ABSENT exclusion)
unknowns: Whether renders of isolated parts give the model enough context; may need a second sheet with the part highlighted in the whole scan
Agreement rate between the model's choices and the user's on the crawfish set; target >= 80% on parts where the user has a clear preference
How to identify a member by surface point in DSL when members overlap almost completely after alignment; may need point + member fingerprint
